about: The singular offering is asked to loosen the bonds of our wickedness and obtain gifts of mercy. The martyrs’ birth-feast celebrations form the setting of the offering.

seg.tr: Lord, we offer this sacrifice as we celebrate the heavenly birthdays of Your holy martyrs. We pray that it may loosen the bonds of our wickedness and obtain for us the gifts of Your mercy. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God,

a.g: as we celebrate the heavenly birthdays of Your holy martyrs
may loosen the bonds of our wickedness
obtain for us the gifts of Your mercy
who lives and reigns with You

ex.w001: The same offering is the subject of both requests: loosening the bonds and obtaining gifts of mercy.
ex.w005: The offering is what we present. The celebrating is done by the praying community.
ex.w009: The word names the martyrs’ birth-feast celebrations. The feast recalls their birth into heavenly life.
ex.w010: The praying community celebrates the martyrs while offering the sacrifice.
ex.w019: We ask that the offering obtain the gifts of God’s mercy for us.
ex.w039: The word “God” refers to the Son, who lives and reigns with the Father in the unity of the Holy Spirit.
